content:
anika: Heads-up — PR #24312 is green locally but CI is flaky on mac-e2e. Hoping to land before Tue maintenance blackout. Can someone eyeball and /assign @mike?

mike: On it. Which tests are failing?

anika: auth-integration::session-timeout is the one. Failing job: https://ci.redwood.example/job/24312/6 — logs show a timeout in the mock server handshake.

joel: I saw that flake earlier this week. Rerunning usually clears it. Do we have a rebase/merge window before the blackout?

anika: We have a short rebase window Tue 21:00 UTC. If we miss it we must defer until Wed morning (ops prefers no merges during the blackout).

ci-bot: RERUN queued by @mike — /ci rerun job 24312 #6

mike: Rerun kicked off. If it flakes again, proposal: land a manual canary (small traffic) then promote after observations. @caroline any concerns with canary route?

caroline: No concerns from my side — manual canary is fine. What's the tolerance window for rollback?

mike: Canary will be 10% traffic for 10 minutes, automatic rollback if error rate > 1% or latency +200ms. Low-risk change (cache expiry tweak).

anika: Quick config diff in PR: 
```
env:
  CACHE_EXPIRY_MS: 2000
tests:
  retry: 1
```
Should be safe. If rerun passes I'll ping release and land before 21:00 UTC. If not, requesting a small Wed morning rebase slot and will fast-follow.

joel: SGTM. Also note: avoid landing within 1h of blackout start — ops asked we keep that buffer.

ops-bot: :warning: Reminder — maintenance blackout starts Tue 22:00 UTC. No merges during blackout window.

mike: Rerun passed ✅ — all lanes green. I'm going to add my approval in PR and proceed with merge-on-green + release ping.

caroline: Approved :thumbsup:

anika: Thanks everyone — I'll wait for the final green then land. Leaving the canary fallback plan in the PR description and a note for release about the blackout window.
